title: zfls configuration
description: Options of the zfls (and fortls) Fortran language server; they override the command-line options

incl_suffixes.description: Consider additional file extensions to the default (default: .F90, .F95, .F03, .F05, .F08, .F18, .F23, .FPP, .CUF, .PF, .FYPP, .F, .F77, .FOR, .FTN (lower & upper casing))

excl_suffixes.description: Source file extensions to be excluded (default: set())

comment_markers.description: Further markers that start a comment as ! does, outside strings, such as ;* of a dialect that a preprocessor turns into Fortran

disable_openmp_conditional.description: Read OpenMP conditional compilation lines (!$ followed by a blank, in fixed form also c$ and *$ in column 1) as comments, as a build without OpenMP does; by default they are code

d_lines.description: How a fixed-form line with D or d in column 1 (a debug line) is read: comment, or code (the D is a blank), as compilers do by an option (default: comment)

file_associations.description: The editor's languages of files by glob pattern, as VS Code's files.associations, e.g. {"*.fpp": "FortranFixedForm"}: a .fpp file whose language is FortranFreeForm or FortranFixedForm is read in that form, not as its text suggests (a pattern with / matches the absolute path, one without the file name; the longest matching pattern wins)

nthreads.description: Number of threads to use during workspace initialization (default: 4)

notify_init.description: Send notification message when workspace initialization is complete

recursion_limit.description: Set the maximum recursion depth for the parser (default: 1000)

sort_keywords.description: Display variable keywords information, function/subroutine definitions, etc. in a consistent (sorted) manner default: no sorting, display code as is)

disable_autoupdate.description: Accepted for compatibility with fortls and ignored: zfls does not update itself.

disable_index_cache.description: Do not keep the workspace's files, and what zfls parsed from them, in one file of zfls's cache, from which a start reads those that have not changed instead of reading and parsing each file

autocomplete_no_prefix.description: Do not filter autocomplete results by variable prefix

autocomplete_no_auto_use.description: Do not offer the public names of modules that are not used yet (completing one adds its USE statement)

autocomplete_no_snippets.description: Do not use snippets with place holders in autocomplete results

autocomplete_name_only.description: Complete only the name of procedures and not the parameters

lowercase_intrinsics.description: Use lowercase for intrinsics and keywords in autocomplete requests

use_signature_help.description: Use signature help instead of subroutine/function snippets. This effectively sets --autocomplete_no_snippets

hover_signature.description: Hover on an actual argument of a call also shows the dummy argument it is passed to

hover_language.description: Language used for responses to hover requests a VSCode language id (default: fortran90)

doc_math.description: The formulas of documentation comments (\f$ x \f$, \( x \), \f[ x \f]) in hover, completion and signature help: keep (as written), dollar ($x$ and $$x$$, for clients that render math) or plain (in backticks, without the markers) (default: keep)

prefer_implementation.description: Hover and go to definition use the implementation of a procedure declared in an interface (e.g. a separate module procedure in a submodule) instead of the interface

lowercase_hover.description: Show the keywords of hover in lowercase (real, intent(in) :: x)

hover_no_type_components.description: Hover on a derived type or a variable of one does not list the type's components and type-bound procedures

hover_plain_comments.description: Plain comments directly above a declaration, at the end of its line or right under a procedure's header are its documentation when it has no !>, !< or !! documentation

fixed_line_length.description: Columns of code in a fixed-form line, as gfortran's -ffixed-line-length-n (72, 80, 132): the rest is highlighted as a comment and is not read for names (default: -1, no limit)

diagnostics_change_delay.description: The milliseconds without a change before the diagnostics of a document that is edited are published again (default: 300; 0: with each change; negative: only when it is opened and saved)

workspace_diagnostics.description: Publish the diagnostics of every file of the workspace, not only of the open ones (after initialization, and again when files change)

diagnostic_severity.description: Severity of the diagnostics of each code, e.g. {"masks-parent": "off"}: off, error, warning, information or hint

external_modules.description: Modules from outside the project (glob patterns, e.g. mpi petsc*) that USE statements name without a diagnostic

compiler_diagnostics.description: Check each file with a compiler when it is opened and saved, and publish its errors and warnings with zfls's diagnostics: gfortran, ifx, ifort, flang, nvfortran, nagfor or lfortran (default: none). The modules a file uses are compiled first

compiler_path.description: The compiler executable, or the directory that holds it (default: the one on the PATH)

compiler_args.description: The compiler's arguments, separated by spaces (or a JSON list) on the command line and a list in a configuration file (default: the compiler's warnings, e.g. -Wall for gfortran). Include directories and preprocessor definitions are added

compiler_diagnostics_fixed.description: The compiler that checks fixed-form files, as compiler_diagnostics, or none (default: compiler_diagnostics). The modules a file uses are compiled with the compiler of the file

compiler_path_fixed.description: The executable of compiler_diagnostics_fixed, as compiler_path (default: compiler_path)

compiler_args_fixed.description: The arguments of the compiler for fixed-form files, as compiler_args (default: compiler_args; empty: the compiler's defaults)

lint_dialect.description: The dialect zfls's own checks lint against: neutral (only what gfortran, ifx and Flang agree on), gfortran, ifx or flang, which also reports that compiler's quirks as you type (default: the dialect of compiler_diagnostics, else neutral)

compiler_mod_dir.description: Where the compiler writes .mod files, relative to the root (default: a directory in zfls's cache)

compiler_include_dirs.description: Further include directories for the compiler, relative to the root; glob patterns match directories (zfls's include_dirs are passed too)

compiler_no_save.description: Do not check a file with the compiler when it is saved, only when it is opened (and while it is edited, with compiler_on_change)

compiler_on_change.description: Also check a file while it is edited: its unsaved text, after compiler_change_delay milliseconds without a change

compiler_change_delay.description: With compiler_on_change, the milliseconds without a change before a check (default: 1000)

compiler_no_dependencies.description: Do not compile the workspace modules a file uses before checking it, nor check again the open files that use a module when its file is saved

compiler_no_compile_commands.description: Do not check a file with the arguments of its command in compile_commands.json (used when compiler_args is not set)

compiler_fypp.description: Run fypp (this executable) on each file before the compiler checks it, with line markers naming the file (default: none)

compiler_fypp_args.description: fypp's further arguments (-I, -D, ...), separated by spaces (or a JSON list) on the command line and a list in a configuration file

fortitude.description: Lint files with fortitude (pip install fortitude-lint) when they are opened and saved: its problems are warnings, its fixes quick fixes, and source.fixAll.fortitude applies the safe ones

fortitude_path.description: fortitude's executable (default: the one on the PATH)

fortitude_args.description: fortitude check's further arguments, such as --select; separated by spaces (or a JSON list) on the command line and a list in a configuration file

fortitude_on_change.description: Also lint a file with fortitude while it is edited, after fortitude_change_delay milliseconds without a change

fortitude_change_delay.description: With fortitude_on_change, the milliseconds without a change before linting (default: 500)

codee.description: Check files with Codee (codee checks, a commercial tool) when they are opened and saved

codee_path.description: Codee's executable (default: the one on the PATH)

codee_args.description: codee checks's further arguments; ${file} stands for the file (else it comes last). Separated by spaces (or a JSON list) on the command line and a list in a configuration file

formatter.description: Format documents and selections with findent, fprettify, codee (Codee's codee format), forformat, or custom (formatter_path with formatter_args), installed separately, which zfls gives the text on stdin and reads the result from stdout (default: none)

formatter_path.description: The formatter executable, or the directory that holds it (default: the one on the PATH; for codee, codee_path's); the command of the custom formatter

formatter_args.description: The formatter's further arguments, separated by spaces (or a JSON list) on the command line and a list in a configuration file. findent gets -ifree or -ifixed from the file's form unless these set the input format, and -Ia (keep the indentation) for a selection; fprettify also reads .fprettify.rc files from the file's directory up; codee gets format - -o -, forformat --stdin-filename=FILE and -ifree or -ifixed; for custom they are the whole command line, in which ${file} is the document's path and ${form} free or fixed

formatter_fixed.description: The formatter of fixed-form files: findent, codee, forformat, custom, or none (default: the formatter option's; fprettify formats free form only)

formatter_fixed_args.description: The further arguments of formatter_fixed, as formatter_args

symbol_skip_mem.description: Do not include type members in document symbol results

disable_bind_c_search.description: Go to definition of a BIND(C) procedure does not search the workspace's C files for its C declaration (an editor with a C language server can ask that instead)

bind_c_clangd.description: Start this clangd (its path, or clangd for the one on the PATH) and ask it for the C declarations and calls of BIND(C) procedures too, besides zfls's search of the C files: its index of the project's compile_commands.json has those of headers outside the source directories and of names a macro makes

code_lens_no_references.description: Do not show the number of references above each module, procedure and derived type (a code lens, counted when the editor shows it)

code_lens_no_run.description: Do not show Run and Debug above a program (code lenses, for an editor that has those commands, as the VS Code extension does)

pp_suffixes.description: File extensions to be parsed ONLY for preprocessor commands (default: all uppercase source file suffixes, and .fpp)

pp_defs.description: A dictionary with additional preprocessor definitions. Preprocessor definitions are normally included via INCLUDE_DIRS

include_dirs.description: Folders containing preprocessor files with extensions PP_SUFFIXES.

compile_commands.description: compile_commands.json (or its directory) whose Fortran entries add include directories and preprocessor definitions; empty for none (default: compile_commands.json in the root, root/build or root/builddir)

disable_intel_directives.description: Read Intel's conditional compilation directives (!DEC$ IF DEFINED (X), !DIR$ IF (expr), ELSEIF, ELSE, ENDIF, DEFINE, UNDEFINE) as comments; by default the branches they leave out are skipped, in every Fortran file

debug_log.description: Generate debug log in project root folder
